episodeTitle.en: A child psychologist’s guide to working with difficult adults | Dr. Becky Kennedy
episodeTitle.zh: 儿童心理学家指导如何与难相处的成年人共事 | 贝基·肯尼迪博士（Dr. Becky Kennedy）

guestBioOfficial.en: Dr. Becky Kennedy is a clinical psychologist, the bestselling author of Good Inside, and the founder of a parenting platform used by millions. Known for her practical, psychology-based approach to parenting, Dr. Becky shares how the same principles that help parents raise resilient children can make you a much more effective leader. In this conversation, she breaks down why all human systems—whether families or companies—operate on the same fundamental principles, and how understanding these dynamics can make you more effective in every relationship. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 贝基·肯尼迪博士是一名临床心理学家、畅销书《内在善良》（Good Inside）的作者，也是拥有数百万用户的育儿平台的创始人。贝基以实用、基于心理学的育儿方法而闻名，她分享了帮助父母培养有韧性的孩子所需的相同原则如何能让你成为更高效的领导者。在对话中，她将剖析为什么所有人类系统——无论是家庭还是公司——都遵循相同的基本原则，以及理解这些动态如何能让你在每一段关系中更高效。*我们将探讨：*

title.en: A child psychologist’s guide to working with difficult adults | Dr. Becky Kennedy
title.zh: 儿童心理学家指导如何与难相处的成年人共事 | 贝基·肯尼迪博士（Dr. Becky Kennedy）

summary.en: Dr. Becky argues most adults in corporate environments behave like “babies in disguise” because all humans need the same things: skills to manage internal difficulty, not just better behavior. She reframes resilience over happiness and separating behavior from identity (“good inside”), and clarifies that boundaries are what you'll do, requiring nothing from the other person. The conversation translates parenting wisdom into practical tools for healthier, more resilient workplaces.
summary.zh: Dr. Becky 认为企业环境中的多数成年人像“伪装成婴儿的成年人”，因为所有人都需要同样的东西：管理内在困境的技能，而非只是更好的行为。她把“韧性优于快乐”、行为与身份分离（“内在是好的”）重新框定，并澄清边界是“你会做什么”、无需对方配合。对话把育儿智慧转化为打造更健康、更有韧性职场的实用工具。
